max_drawdown_convention.note: Drawdown LEVELS in this file are NEGATIVE: minimum of (cumulative daily return - running peak); return units for the published books, dollars at minimum size for the dollar books (D542).

universe.tie_rule: (-signal, root symbol): ties rank the alphabetically earlier root higher

root_month.units: contribution to the book's daily return, summed within the month

term_structure.legs: long the top ceil(n/3), short the bottom ceil(n/3), same eligibility, ties by root symbol

momentum.legs: long the top ceil(n/3), short the bottom ceil(n/3), same eligibility, ties by root symbol

component_line.rho_with_ledger_entry: ABSENT: the MACD arm's per-session P&L series is not on disk
component_line.cost_line: $3 a round trip on a micro, $6 on a full contract, plus one tick crossed; a roll is two sides

P-1.claim: primary > 0 and above N1 p95; gross point range 0.28-0.45 (deposit net 0.25-0.40 + turnover drag)

P-2.claim: Sharpe uplift over the better single sort < mean-return uplift in that sort's vol units

P-3.claim: double sort ann. vol > both single sorts' ann. vol

P-4.claim: top-1 root abs share of the primary's P&L > 30%

P-5.claim: daily rho with each single sort > 0.4

P-6.claim: the 16-root dollar book fails C-d (daily sigma > $500)

P-7.claim: falsifier: gates green and primary below N1 p50 -> the sort did badly on this window

amendment_unfloored_1m.note: UNPROMOTABLE diagnostic; not the pre-registered rule; recorded because the pre-registered 20-return floor on the 1-month cell excluded root-months on calendar length
amendment_unfloored_1m.rule: tot12 (D555 floor, live at m) minus the plain calendar-month sum with no count floor; eligible iff the 12-month cell and the carry are finite
